title: Query route implemented but never mounted — /api/v1/ontology/query always 404s
description: routes/query.ts defines createQueryRoutes (POST /api/v1/ontology/query + /validate) and query-service.ts is fully implemented, but createQueryRoutes/createQueryService are never imported or mounted in routes/index.ts or index.ts. The entire structured-query feature is dead code returning 404 in production.
fix: Import createQueryRoutes in routes/index.ts, instantiate createQueryService in index.ts (db, entityRepo, fieldRepo), and add app.route('/', createQueryRoutes({ queryService })) in registerRoutes.

title: Selecting system columns (_id, _created_at, …) throws in SQL generation
description: SYSTEM_COLUMNS pass validation (added to fieldSlugs) but buildSelectSql/buildWhereFragment route them through quotePgIdentifier whose regex /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$/ rejects leading underscores and throws 'Invalid PostgreSQL identifier: "_id"'. Only wildcard '*' select is safe. (Currently unreachable over HTTP because of P19-001, but the service logic is genuinely broken.)
fix: Detect identifiers starting with '_' and quote them directly ('"' + col + '"') instead of via quotePgIdentifier, or add a quoteSystemColumn helper for the known-safe system columns.

title: Migration set to 'confirmed' on auto-commit pool before advisory lock — irrecoverable orphan state
description: confirmMigration calls migrationRepo.setConfirmed on the pool (auto-commit) BEFORE acquiring pg_try_advisory_xact_lock in a transaction. If the lock fails, status='confirmed' is already committed; findActiveByEntityId includes 'confirmed' so all future patches on the entity are blocked, and retrying confirm throws MigrationWrongStateError. The entity is permanently stuck with no recovery path.
fix: Move setConfirmed inside the advisory-lock transaction on the client connection (setConfirmedWithClient) so confirmation and lock acquisition are atomic; only commit if both succeed.

title: setRunning uses pool, not tx client — atomicity gap with CREATE VIEW
description: CREATE VIEW DDL runs on the tx client, but migrationRepo.setRunning runs on the shared pool (auto-commit). If client COMMIT then fails, the view is rolled back but status='running' is already persisted, leaving consumers seeing 'running' with no migration view.
fix: Pass the transaction client to setRunning so the status update and CREATE VIEW are in the same transaction.

title: LIKE operator escapes all wildcards — pattern matching impossible
description: The 'like' branch escapes %, _ and backslash from user input then uses ESCAPE '\', turning 'foo%' into a literal match for the string 'foo%'. Prefix/suffix/contains patterns are impossible; LIKE behaves as case-sensitive equality.
fix: Only escape the backslash from user input, not % or _, so user-supplied wildcards work; document that clients supply the full LIKE pattern.

title: deleteRelationship has no tenant isolation (currently unreachable)
description: deleteRelationship(id) calls relationshipRepo.delete(id) with no tenant_id filter or prior tenant check. Adversarial verification found NO HTTP route and no callers outside the definition/tests, so the path is currently unreachable — but the latent gap should be closed before any caller is wired.
fix: Accept tenantId, verify the relationship's tenant before deleting, or add AND tenant_id = $2 to the DELETE.

title: TOCTOU: countDataRows check for required-NOT-NULL column add not in same tx as DDL
description: patchEntity checks hasData via countDataRows outside the transaction; a concurrent ingest can insert rows before the ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN NOT NULL runs, causing a raw PG constraint error rather than a clean ConflictError.
fix: Run countDataRows inside the DDL transaction with LOCK TABLE IN SHARE MODE, or always require a default for added NOT NULL columns.

title: Stored defaultExpression spliced into CREATE VIEW DDL without re-validation
description: buildUnionViewDDL splices f.defaultExpression directly into SQL. It is validated at create time but the cast from stored change_plan JSONB back to the typed array is unchecked, so a tampered/malformed expression would execute when confirmMigration builds the view.
fix: Re-validate each defaultExpression against the create-time allowlist (string literal / finite number / boolean / NULL) before passing to buildUnionViewDDL.

title: N+1 queries per entity in buildSnapshot
description: buildSnapshot issues 3 queries per entity (fields, relationships, active migration) in a loop — up to 30000 sequential round-trips for a 1000-entity tenant on each cache miss. fieldRepo.findByEntityIds (batch) exists but is unused.
fix: Batch-load fields/relationships/active-migrations with IN-based queries once outside the loop.

title: User-supplied appName injected into generated TSX source (template literal) without escaping
description: renderDefaultTemplate and all 8 template files (dashboard.ts:101, crud-admin.ts:79, form-builder.ts:77, etc.) interpolate appName directly into backtick template literals that BECOME generated TSX source stored in the VFS and later compiled by Execution Service. CreateAppSchema is z.string().min(1).max(128) with no character restriction, so backticks and ${...} break out and inject arbitrary code. Persistent code-injection path.
fix: Escape appName (backticks, backslashes, ${) before interpolation, or emit via JSON.stringify as a JSX expression {…}. Apply to slug too.

title: update() writes updated_at but app.builds has no such column — every build update throws
description: DeploymentRepository.update() unconditionally appends 'updated_at = now()', but the app.builds table in 001_initial_schema.sql has no updated_at column (and BUILD_COLUMNS omits it). Every build state transition (building/success/failed) throws 'column "updated_at" does not exist', failing all builds.
fix: Remove the updated_at set, or add an updated_at column via migration and to BUILD_COLUMNS/BuildRow (needed by recoverInterruptedBuilds).

title: recoverInterruptedBuilds filters on non-existent updated_at column
description: The startup recovery query uses 'AND updated_at < $1' but app.builds has no updated_at column, so the query throws on every service startup and interrupted builds remain stuck in pending/building indefinitely.
fix: Add updated_at to app.builds (preferred), or filter on created_at as a proxy with a wider grace window.

title: isOriginAllowed strips port but patterns include port — port-qualified origins never match (DoS)
description: isOriginAllowed extracts new URL(requestOrigin).hostname (no port), but allowed patterns may include a port (regex permits :\d+). A stored pattern like example.com:8080 never equals the port-stripped hostname, so all requests from that origin are rejected — embed lockout.
fix: Use new URL(requestOrigin).host (includes port) and store patterns in host form, or compare both hostname and host.

title: PATCH /:id/oauth is a stub returning fabricated acknowledgment
description: The handler validates the body and checks ownership but returns a synthetic {appId, additionalRedirectUris, updatedAt} without calling the Auth Service. DELETE /:id/oauth/dev-redirect-uris is the same. Configured redirect URIs are never persisted; callers wrongly believe they applied.
fix: Call Auth Service PATCH /internal/oauth/clients/:clientId/redirect-uris with a service token; until then return 501.

title: DELETE /files/:path does not call validateFilePath
description: PUT (202) and rename (291-292) call validateFilePath before DB ops, but the DELETE handler decodes the path and only checks the entrypoint guard — no extension/traversal validation (defense-in-depth gap; the DB query itself is parameterized).
fix: Call validateFilePath(filePath) in the DELETE handler before the entrypoint guard.

title: listBuilds returns total of all builds when filterStatus is set
description: When filterStatus is supplied, listByApp applies the status filter but countByApp counts ALL builds regardless of status, so the returned total (and pagination) is wrong for filtered queries.
fix: Add countByAppAndStatus and use it when filterStatus is defined.

title: BFF data proxy forwards all client query params verbatim to execution service
description: queryParams = new URLSearchParams(c.req.query()).toString() is appended to the upstream URL with no allowlist, letting a user inject arbitrary params (limit overrides, debug flags, potential tenant overrides).
fix: Allowlist permitted query params (filter, limit, cursor, sort) before forwarding.

title: Slug conflict check in createApp/updateApp has TOCTOU race
description: Slug existence is read then INSERT performed in separate non-transactional calls; a concurrent insert causes a raw 23505 PG error instead of AppSlugConflictError.
fix: Catch unique-constraint violations (23505) and convert to AppSlugConflictError; treat pre-flight reads as advisory.

title: listByApp reports size_bytes as character count while writes use byte length
description: FILE_META_COLUMNS uses length(content) (characters) but PUT/rename and the 1MB limit use Buffer.byteLength (bytes). For multibyte UTF-8 the list under-reports size and can show a file as within-limit that was rejected at write time.
fix: Use octet_length(content) in FILE_META_COLUMNS.

title: Parallel-branch steps never inserted into run_steps
description: createBatch maps only definition.steps (top-level). Steps nested in ParallelBranch.steps are never inserted, so updateStatus on them returns null silently — branch steps are invisible in the DB, unaudited, and their failures write no error row.
fix: Recursively flatten branch steps (collectAllStepsFlat) and use that for createBatch and startExecution.

title: Critical hook failures return early without notifying ExecutionTracker — SSE streams hang
description: after:pipeline.trigger (1508) and before:pipeline.complete (1866) failure paths set DB status='failed' and return WITHOUT calling executionTracker.completeExecution, so SSE subscribers never get a terminal event and their stream stays open indefinitely.
fix: Call executionTracker.completeExecution(runId, 'failed') before each early return; also run after:complete hooks.

title: Sub-workflow call-stack/cycle detection is in-process only
description: subWorkflowCallStack lives on RunContext and is reseeded to [] in each processRun. PipelineRunJobPayload carries only {runId, tenantId}, so when a sub-workflow is enqueued as a new BullMQ job the ancestry is lost — cross-job cycles (A enqueues B enqueues A) are not detected.
fix: Add subWorkflowCallStack to PipelineRunJobPayload, forward it in triggerRun, and seed it from job.data in processRun.

title: SSRF blocklist missing 0.0.0.0 and has duplicate 169.254.169.254 — save/runtime asymmetry
description: pipeline-service's SSRF_BLOCKED_PATTERNS omits 0.0.0.0 and duplicates the metadata IP. execution-engine.ts:237 DOES block 0.0.0.0, so a pipeline URL of http://0.0.0.0 saves successfully but is blocked at runtime (asymmetric, confusing, and 0.0.0.0 routes to localhost on many OSes).
fix: Add the 0.0.0.0 pattern to pipeline-service, remove the duplicate, and extract a shared SSRF blocklist constant.

title: Webhook body JSONata template runs unsandboxed with 5s timeout and $eval
description: step.body starting with '=' is evaluated via jsonata() with a 5s timeout in-process. JSONata's $eval can evaluate arbitrary expressions, widening the DoS window; the conditional path uses a tighter 100ms timeout.
fix: Disable $eval on the parsed expression, set a node-count limit, and lower the webhook timeout.

title: Schedule next_run_at advanced before dependency check — skipped ticks lost
description: cronTick advances next_run_at (claims the tick) before checking dependencies; if deps are unsatisfied the tick is skipped and permanently lost (e.g. an entire day for @daily on a transient dependency failure).
fix: Check dependencies before advancing next_run_at, or revert next_run_at when deps are not satisfied.

title: Run log SSE stream has no client-disconnect detection — polling loop leaks
description: The runs SSE log stream comments that it cannot detect client disconnect; the while(isStreamActive) loop keeps polling the DB every 500ms until the run terminates, leaking a connection slot per disconnected client. executions.ts uses c.req.raw.signal correctly.
fix: Use c.req.raw.signal abort listener to set isStreamActive=false and close the controller.

title: Schedule dependsOn implemented in service/DB but not exposed in API schema
description: ScheduleService supports dependsOn and the DB has depends_on, but CreateScheduleSchema/PatchScheduleSchema omit dependsOn and the route never passes it, so schedule dependencies can never be set via the API.
fix: Add dependsOn to the schemas and pass it through the route handlers.

title: Docker sandbox containers missing PidsLimit, SecurityOpt (seccomp/no-new-privileges), and non-root User
description: createDockerContainer sets CapDrop:[ALL], ReadonlyRootfs, Memory, NanoCpus, NetworkMode but omits PidsLimit (fork-bomb), SecurityOpt seccomp/no-new-privileges (full syscall surface), and User (runs as root). The HostConfig interface doesn't even declare these fields.
fix: Add PidsLimit, SecurityOpt:[seccomp=…, no-new-privileges:true], and User:'1000:1000' to HostConfig and the create body.

title: recordCompletion deletes from wrong instance after blue-green promotion
description: recordCompletion always operates on the module-level current primary. An execution started on the old primary (added to oldPrimary.inflightIds) that completes after the swap deletes from the NEW primary, leaving the id stuck in oldPrimary.inflightIds; drain then waits the full grace period and fires a false onCrash for a successfully-completed execution.
fix: Capture the SandboxInstance reference at recordRun time (or maintain an executionId→instance map) so recordCompletion targets the correct instance.

title: User-controlled fetch request body has no size cap — outbound DoS / bandwidth amplification
description: handleFetch spreads the user-supplied RequestInit (including body) into the outbound fetch; the response is capped at 50MB but the request body is not, so sandbox code can POST hundreds of MB using the service's egress.
fix: Cap init.body byte length (e.g. 10MB) and restrict init to a safe allowlist (method, headers, body).

title: Pagination cursor lookup not tenant-scoped — cross-tenant timing disclosure (IDOR)
description: The cursor row lookup 'SELECT started_at FROM execution.executions WHERE id=$1' has no tenant filter, so a user can pass another tenant's execution UUID as the cursor and learn its started_at timestamp.
fix: Add AND tenant_id=$2 to the cursor lookup; skip the cursor condition if the row is not found.

title: Docker AutoRemove:true makes memory stats always 0
description: Containers are created with AutoRemove:true; after waitForDockerContainer returns the container is already removed, so getDockerContainerStats hits 404 and returns memoryPeakMb:0 for all Python/Go executions.
fix: Collect stats before the container exits (streaming) or disable AutoRemove and clean up manually after stats are captured.

title: Logout skips access-token revocation for cookie sessions and never clears cookies
description: Logout reads the JTI only from the Authorization Bearer header. Browser cookie-auth sessions (op_access_token cookie) never get their access token added to the revocation blocklist, and the 204 response sets no Set-Cookie, so both cookies persist (refresh cookie for the full 7-day window).
fix: Read the access token from the op_access_token cookie as a fallback, and expire both cookies via Set-Cookie in the logout response.

title: OAuth state GET+DEL uses non-atomic pipeline — TOCTOU replay
description: The state validation uses redis.pipeline().get().del().exec(), which batches but is NOT atomic; two concurrent callbacks for the same state can both read the value before either DEL lands, allowing authorization-code replay. The comment falsely claims 'Atomic GET + DEL'. An atomic Lua GETDEL is used correctly elsewhere.
fix: Use the atomic Lua GETDEL (RedisStore.getAndDeleteOAuthState) instead of the pipeline.

title: Two contradictory lockout implementations (5 vs hardcoded 10)
description: The login flow uses inline SQL with readLockoutMaxAttempts() (default 5), while UserRepository.incrementFailedLogin hardcodes a threshold of 10. incrementFailedLogin has no callers (dead code) — a second, contradictory lockout implementation that will mislead maintainers.
fix: Delete incrementFailedLogin or align it with readLockoutMaxAttempts.

title: USER_COLUMNS omits password_history — repository never returns it
description: USER_COLUMNS lacks password_history, so findById/findByEmail never return it; auth-service reads it via separate inline queries. UserRow declares the field but the repository User type does not, so code relying on repository results gets undefined.
fix: Add password_history to USER_COLUMNS and the User type, and use the repository consistently.

title: SCIM list deep-paging is O(N) and silently returns empty beyond MAX_LIMIT
description: listByTenant uses keyset pagination but SCIM emulates offset by fetching count+(startIndex-1) rows and slicing in memory. For startIndex > MAX_LIMIT (200) the repo clamps the fetch, so pageUsers is empty even when records exist — a silent wrong result with totalResults>0 and empty Resources.
fix: Implement true offset pagination for SCIM, or return a SCIM error past the supported depth.

title: auth:user-sessions Redis set has no TTL — grows unboundedly
description: The refresh-family set gets a 30-day EXPIRE but auth:user-sessions:{userId} never gets one. Naturally-expired tokens are removed only on explicit logout/reset, so the set accumulates stale members for users who never log out, making logout(all)/deactivation an O(N) scan.
fix: Set an expiry on the user-sessions set equal to the refresh TTL, or prune stale members during rotation.

title: Shared JWT middleware does not validate issuer or audience
description: authMiddleware calls jwtVerify with only { algorithms } for both EdDSA and HS256, omitting issuer/audience even though tokens are minted with iss='oneplatform' and aud='oneplatform'. The auth service's own verifyAccessToken passes iss/aud, but the shared core middleware every other service uses does not — enabling cross-issuer/cross-audience token replay across the service boundary.
fix: Add issuer:'oneplatform' and audience:'oneplatform' to both jwtVerify calls.

title: X-User-Context validation omits scopes/isService/isGuest/emailVerified
description: serviceAuthMiddleware validates only userId/tenantId/roles types after HMAC verification, then casts the rest with 'as unknown as UserContext'. A caller able to produce a validly-signed context (holder of OP_JWT_SECRET) can inject scopes:['admin'] / isService:true / emailVerified:true unchecked. The HMAC gate stops external forgery, but the field-validation gap is real.
fix: Validate scopes (array of allowed strings) and the boolean flags; reject on type mismatch.

title: IP allowlist falls back to spoofable X-Forwarded-For
description: parseIpFromRequest returns X-Real-IP when present, else the leftmost client-controllable X-Forwarded-For. On any request path where X-Real-IP isn't injected (proxy bypass/misconfig), an attacker can spoof X-Forwarded-For to an allowlisted IP and bypass the allowlist. The comment even acknowledges XFF is spoofable.
fix: Fail closed (deny / 403) when X-Real-IP is absent and an allowlist is active, rather than trusting XFF.

title: Response envelope drops non-whitelisted response headers
description: When wrapping 2xx JSON, the middleware replaces c.res and copies only an explicit allowlist of headers, silently dropping ETag, Cache-Control, Location, Content-Disposition, Set-Cookie, WWW-Authenticate, and custom headers set by handlers.
fix: Copy all original response headers (overriding only Content-Type) instead of an allowlist.

title: Data-residency 403 leaks internal region topology
description: The 403 body includes tenantRegion and serviceRegion (e.g. US_EAST, EU_WEST_1), letting a caller map internal deployment/region topology by probing.
fix: Return a generic message; log the region mismatch internally with requestId.

title: Audit events lost after BullMQ retry exhaustion (no DLQ)
description: Audit events enqueue with attempts:5 and removeOnFail count:100; there is no DLQ. After the 101st failed audit event the oldest are evicted and permanently lost — a compliance durability gap.
fix: Wire an audit DLQ and move exhausted jobs there, or add a DB/file fallback when enqueue fails.

title: Usage and billing routes imported and wired to repos but never mounted
description: createUsageRoutes and createBillingRoutes are imported, BillingWebhookConfigRepository is created and injected, but no app.route mounts /api/v1/usage or /api/v1/billing — so all usage (summary/history/export) and billing (webhook-config) endpoints 404. The metering tables exist, confirming the routes were meant to be live.
fix: Mount usageRoutes and billingRoutes before the proxy catch-all.

title: Unsafe non-null assertions on validateApiKey response identity fields
description: After body.valid===true the code uses body.userId! / body.tenantId! though both are optional in the auth response type. If the auth service returns {valid:true} without them, downstream tenant-isolation checks compare undefined to real tenant IDs.
fix: Guard with if (!body.userId || !body.tenantId) return null; return them without '!'.

title: GDPR export stores full user PII as a data: URI in the DB
description: The entire PII export (profile + full audit log) is base64-encoded as a data:application/json URI and written to gdpr_requests.result_url with no expiry/size cap, and is served back in-band via any endpoint returning result_url.
fix: Upload the export to object storage under a tenant-scoped key with retention and store only a presigned URL.

title: isBlockedHostname over-broadly blocks any host ending in -service
description: The guard blocks any hostname ending in '-service' to stop internal Docker names, but this also rejects legitimate external FQDNs like delivery-service.example.com or self-service.stripe.com.
fix: Only block bare (dot-less) hostnames ending in -service; rely on DNS resolution checks for FQDNs.

title: Unimplemented gRPC methods return INTERNAL (13) instead of UNIMPLEMENTED (12)
description: UNIMPLEMENTED_STATUS is set to GrpcStatus.INTERNAL because code 12 is missing from the enum. Clients treat 13 as transient and retry in a loop instead of seeing a permanent UNIMPLEMENTED.
fix: Add UNIMPLEMENTED=12 to the enum and use it.

title: Reconciliation report readable cross-connector/cross-tenant (IDOR)
description: GET /:id/reconciliation-reports/:jobId verifies tenant ownership of connector :id but then calls getReport(jobId) without checking report.connectorId === :id, so a tenant owning any connector can read another connector's (possibly another tenant's) report by jobId.
fix: After getReport, verify report.connectorId === :id and return 404 on mismatch.

title: Temp-file batch records permanently lost on BullMQ retry
description: On batch job failure the temp recordsFile is deleted in the catch block, but BullMQ retries reuse the same recordsFile path, so readFile throws ENOENT and the batch fails permanently — all records in that batch are lost. The comment claiming the file is recreated for this batch is false.
fix: Do not delete the temp file on failure; delete only on success and add a separate orphan-sweep.

title: Path traversal in MinIO key via unsanitized filename
description: The object key concatenates user-supplied filename directly: file-uploads/${tenantId}/${uploadJob.id}/${filename}; '../../' sequences can cross virtual path boundaries in some MinIO configs. filename comes from formData/file.name with no sanitization.
fix: Apply path.basename and strip path separators before building the key.

title: Lua progress scripts strip Redis TTL on concurrent terminal update (key leak)
description: incrProgressScript/incrFailedBatchScript call SET without preserving TTL. If a concurrent processBatchJob runs the script right after processSyncJob set the terminal-state key with EX, the SET without TTL makes the key persist forever — an unbounded Redis leak.
fix: Use SET ... KEEPTTL in both Lua scripts.

title: CSV stream TextDecoder not flushed — last multibyte char dropped
description: processCsvStream feeds '' instead of decoder.decode() (flush) when read.done, so an incomplete UTF-8 sequence in the final chunk (no trailing newline) is silently dropped, corrupting the last field. processNdjsonStream flushes correctly.
fix: Use decoder.decode() (flush) on read.done, matching the NDJSON path.

title: CDC sourceId non-idempotent when lsn and position both undefined
description: positionKey falls back to a current timestamp when both lsn and position are undefined, so re-delivery of the same logical CDC event produces a different sourceId/_id and duplicate rows instead of an idempotent upsert.
fix: Use a deterministic fallback (batchId+index) or reject malformed events lacking both LSN and position.

title: No sensitive-field redaction on log event metadata
description: LogEventSchema accepts arbitrary metadata (z.record(z.unknown())) from any logs:* publisher and stores it verbatim in JSONB, so accidental password/secret/token fields are persisted unredacted. The field-audit path DOES redact; the ingestion path doesn't.
fix: Add a redactSensitiveMetadata step in writeBatch/handleMessage reusing the field-audit SENSITIVE_SUBSTRINGS list.

title: Audit export schema lacks max time-range enforcement
description: auditExportQuerySchema validates only endDate>startDate with no upper cap, while auditQuerySchema caps at 90 days. An admin can request a multi-year window forcing a full-table scan; the row limit caps results, not the DB work.
fix: Add a superRefine max-window (e.g. 365 days) to the export schema.

title: Uncaught synchronous exception from 'batch' listeners can crash ingestion
description: this.emit('batch', batch) is not wrapped in try/catch; a synchronous throw from a future SSE listener propagates through flush→push→handleMessage and (with no error listener on redisSubscriber) can crash the process.
fix: Wrap the emit in try/catch and log listener errors.

title: No cryptographic signature verification on plugin bundles
description: signaturePath is accepted but never used; the code comment confirms GPG verification is not implemented (open TODO). Any platform-admin can install unsigned bundles whose arbitrary code runs in the Execution sandbox — the supply-chain gate is absent.
fix: Implement detached-signature verification against a platform keyring before accepting the bundle; block install until then.

title: Marketplace install endpoint lacks authorization
description: POST /api/v1/marketplace/plugins/:id/install checks only user!==null (no role/scope), creating a plugin record directly and bypassing the platform-admin guard of the regular install route. Any tenant user can install plugins.
fix: Require platform-admin role / plugins:install scope before installing.

title: requiredExternalUrls accepts any string including non-HTTP schemes
description: requiredExternalUrls is z.array(z.string()) with no URL validation, so a manifest can declare file:///etc/passwd, redis://internal, or metadata://169.254… which are written verbatim into approved_urls — SSRF if enforced as an allowlist, untrustworthy if not.
fix: Validate https?:// URLs and reject private-range hosts before persisting.

title: Staged hook rows created outside a transaction — orphaned/duplicated on swap failure
description: Staged hooks are inserted before executeAtomicSwap; if the swap fails the staged rows persist, and with no unique constraint a retry re-inserts duplicates, so the next successful swap activates all staged rows → duplicate hook executions per stage.
fix: Insert staged hooks inside the atomic-swap transaction, or add a UNIQUE(plugin_id,instance_id,stage) and use ON CONFLICT.

title: Marketplace install fabricates a bundle_key with no object in MinIO
description: onInstallPlugin sets bundle_key to marketplace/${id}/${version}/bundle.js but no bundle is uploaded, so when the plugin is activated and Execution fetches the bundle, MinIO returns 404 — marketplace-installed plugins are permanently broken.
fix: Require/upload the actual bundle on publish, or trigger upload at install time before creating the record.

title: drain-complete trusts body manifestId over URL path param
description: The handler uses parsed.data.manifestId (body) and ignores the :manifestId path param, so a caller can POST to /internal/plugins/A/drain-complete with body {manifestId:'B'} and prematurely signal drain for B, letting B's atomic swap proceed before its in-flight executions finish.
fix: Use the path param and reject mismatched body manifestId.

title: Incremental pagination resets offset to 0 on first HWM advance — data loss
description: On a full first batch with since===null, nextOffset resets to 0 with since=HWM; the next query uses strict 'col > HWM' with no PK tiebreaker, so rows whose incremental column equals the boundary value but fell beyond the first batch are dropped. Unlike connector-postgres, MySQL has no lastId tiebreaker.
fix: Only reset offset when since!==null (subsequent runs); within a run keep advancing offset, or add a PK tiebreaker (keyset).

title: HWM comparison corrupts when proxy returns Date objects for DATETIME
description: findHighWaterMark does String(value) on non-numeric values; a Date object stringifies to a locale string that always compares lexicographically larger than ISO strings, so the HWM advances to an unparseable string that MySQL then rejects, silently ending ingestion. extractTimestampField already normalizes via toISOString but findHighWaterMark doesn't.
fix: Normalize Date to toISOString before comparison in findHighWaterMark.

title: Incremental sync terminates early when a full batch is entirely deduped
description: hasMore/nextCursor are set only inside if (records.length>0). When a full proxy batch (rows.length===batchSize) is entirely removed by client-side dedup, records is empty, the block is skipped, and the function returns hasMore:false/nextCursor:null — terminating the sync even though the proxy signalled more rows.
fix: Derive hasMore from payload.rows.length===batchSize before the records.length>0 guard; only null the cursor when both !hasMore and records empty.

title: fetchTableSchema during connect bypasses fetchWithRetry
description: fetchTableSchema uses a bare fetch with no retry, while every fetchBatch path uses fetchWithRetry (3 retries on 503/network). A single transient proxy 503 during connect() aborts sync setup that would survive mid-run.
fix: Wrap the connect-time schema fetch with fetchWithRetry.

title: Keyset cursor mode mismatch silently re-syncs whole table
description: On a cursor-mode mismatch, fetchBatchKeyset logs a warn and resets lastPkValue=null (full re-sync, re-delivering every row), whereas offset/incremental modes throw PluginConfigError. The inconsistency causes silent data duplication after a config change.
fix: Throw PluginConfigError on keyset mode mismatch (or at least log that a full re-ingest will occur).

title: No scheme/private-IP validation on baseUrl — SSRF
description: parseConfig only rejects embedded credentials; no scheme allowlist or private-IP check, so file:///etc/passwd, http://169.254.169.254 (metadata), http://localhost/admin all pass.
fix: Enforce https?:// scheme and a private/loopback/link-local denylist (or delegate to the platform's allowlisted fetch sandbox).

title: Redirect target not validated for private IPs — SSRF via open redirect
description: The manual redirect handler strips auth headers cross-origin but follows the Location URL with no scheme/private-IP validation, so a public API returning Location: http://169.254.169.254/… is fetched and its body returned as records.
fix: Validate the redirect target host against the same private-IP/scheme denylist before following.

title: Incremental sync 'since' is never populated — always full-fetch
description: computeNextCursor always passes since: previousCursor?.since, which is undefined on the first call and stays undefined forever; no code extracts the max incrementalField value from records. supportsIncremental:true is therefore false and every sync is a full fetch.
fix: Compute max(incrementalField) over fetched records and carry it in the cursor on every call.

title: Link-header regex fails when rel is not the first parameter
description: The regex anchors rel immediately after the URL, so RFC 8288 headers with a type/title param before rel (e.g. <url>; type="…"; rel="next") produce no match, returning null and terminating pagination early (data loss).
fix: Parse link entries generically (split on comma respecting <>, then on ;) and find the rel param anywhere.

title: Endpoint path traversal escapes the base-path prefix
description: buildUrl concatenates the raw endpoint then new URL() normalizes .. segments, so endpoint '/../../admin/secret' on baseUrl https://host/v1 resolves to https://host/admin/secret, escaping the /v1 prefix.
fix: Assert the resolved pathname starts with the base pathname, or strip leading ../ from the endpoint.

title: HMAC verification has no replay/timestamp window
description: verifySignature checks only the HMAC digest; payload.receivedAt is never compared to current time, so a captured valid signed payload can be replayed indefinitely and re-ingested as a new record.
fix: Reject payloads whose receivedAt is outside a configurable window (e.g. 300s) before accepting.

title: maxPayloadBytes enforced with JS string length, not byte length
description: The size guard compares payload.rawBody.length (UTF-16 char count) against a byte-named limit, so CJK/emoji payloads can exceed the declared byte maximum by up to ~3x.
fix: Measure new TextEncoder().encode(rawBody).length for the check.

title: secret!==undefined guard can silently skip HMAC verification
description: The per-payload condition includes secret!==undefined; if credentials.get() ever resolves to undefined, all payloads in the batch are accepted without signature verification and no log entry.
fix: Assert a non-empty secret before the loop and remove the per-payload undefined check.

title: Pending-index read-modify-write is not atomic — concurrent fetchBatch double-processes
description: fetchBatch reads the pending index, slices a page, processes, and writes the pruned index without a lock; concurrent calls for the same instance read the same snapshot and double-process payloads. context.cache.lock() exists for this.
fix: Acquire a distributed lock around the read-modify-write and release in finally.

title: ID token audience check skipped when aud absent/empty
description: The check 'if (audValues.length>0 && !audValues.includes(clientId))' short-circuits when aud is missing, so an ID token with no aud claim passes audience validation (RFC 7519 §4.1.3 requires rejection).
fix: Require client_id presence: reject when audValues is empty OR does not include clientId.

title: ID token consumed without signature/exp/iss/nonce verification; nonce never generated
description: handleCallback decodes the id_token with decodeJwtPayloadUnsafe and only partially checks aud — exp, iss, iat and nonce are never validated, and getAuthorizationUrl generates no nonce at all (absent end-to-end), so OIDC replay protection is missing.
fix: Generate and store a nonce in getAuthorizationUrl, verify signature (JWKS), exp, iss and nonce in handleCallback.

title: Static discovery/JWKS cache keys cause cross-issuer leakage
description: DISCOVERY_CACHE_KEY ('oidc:discovery') and JWKS_CACHE_KEY ('oidc:jwks', jwks.ts:81) are static constants with no issuer in the key. Multiple plugin instances for different issuers collide, so one issuer's discovery/JWKS can be used to verify another's tokens (signature-verification cross-contamination).
fix: Include the issuerUrl/jwksUri in the cache keys.

title: Absent OAuth state silently falls back instead of rejecting (CSRF)
description: handleCallback only acts on state when present; if state is undefined it falls back to tenant config redirectUri instead of treating the request as a CSRF attempt and rejecting.
fix: Make state required; throw if absent or not found in the state cache.

title: ECDSA hash selected from JWT header alg while key imported from JWK alg
description: verifySignatureWithKeySet imports the key using the JWK's alg but selects the ECDSA hash from the JWT header alg; a mismatch (JWK ES384 vs header ES256) verifies a P-384 key with SHA-256, silently failing all legitimate tokens for that key.
fix: Derive the hash from the imported key's namedCurve, not the JWT header alg.

title: validateToken DN scope check uses bare endsWith without RDN boundary
description: The scope guard is !searchBase.endsWith(baseDN) with no comma boundary, so a sibling/child-tree DN (or malformed DN) whose textual suffix matches baseDN passes, letting the service-account search arbitrary entries and map roles from non-user objects — privilege escalation.
fix: Require token === baseDN OR token.endsWith(',' + baseDN) (RDN boundary).

title: Service-account bind password not validated non-empty before bind
description: requireBindPassword returns credentials.get() with no empty check; an empty bind credential is sent as the bind password, which many LDAP servers treat as an anonymous bind returning success. The user-password path correctly rejects empty passwords; the service-account path does not.
fix: Throw PluginConfigError if the bind password is empty before binding.

title: memberOf DN RFC 4514 hex escapes not decoded — group mapping silently fails
description: extractMemberOfGroups unescapes only backslash-char sequences, not hex escapes like \2c, so cn=Finance\2cLegal yields 'Finance2cLegal' and misses the groupMapping lookup, silently dropping the associated role (affects OpenLDAP/FreeIPA).
fix: Decode \HH hex escapes (then single-char backslash escapes) per RFC 4514.

title: Gateway publicRoutes omit OAuth and JWKS endpoints — login broken
description: publicRoutes lacks /api/v1/oauth/:provider/authorize, /callback, and /api/v1/auth/.well-known/jwks.json. The gateway auth middleware runs first and returns 401 for these, so OAuth browser login and JWKS key fetch are blocked in any deployed environment. (proxy SERVICE_MAP also lacks an 'oauth' key, compounding it.)
fix: Add the OAuth and JWKS paths to publicRoutes and add an 'oauth' SERVICE_MAP entry.

title: *_SERVICE_URL env vars set only for gateway — all other direct service calls hit wrong ports
description: Compose sets PORT=3000 for every service but defines *_SERVICE_URL only in the gateway block; the entrypoint never exports them. So execution/pipeline/ontology/app fall back to hardcoded wrong ports (e.g. plugin:3008, ingestion:3002, execution:3005) and every direct service-to-service call fails with ECONNREFUSED.
fix: Set the *_SERVICE_URL env vars (all :3000) in each service's compose block (and fix hardcoded :3005 fallbacks in ingestion sync/reconciliation services).

title: Execution service sends plain OP_SERVICE_TOKEN where Ed25519 JWT is required
description: Execution loads serviceToken=process.env.OP_SERVICE_TOKEN ?? '' (and compose doesn't even set it) and sends it raw as X-Service-Token, but serviceAuthMiddleware splits on '.' and verifies an Ed25519 JWT, so all execution→internal calls (credentials.get, plugin cache, pipeline trigger) return 401. pipeline/app/ontology use createServiceTokenSigner; execution has none.
fix: Wire createServiceTokenSigner('execution-service') with an Ed25519 key and sign outbound internal calls; register the public key in callee services. Same gap affects the plugin service and gateway OP_SERVICE_TOKEN path.

title: connector-registry and analytics mounts missing from gateway SERVICE_MAP
description: Ingestion mounts /api/v1/connector-registry (and dual-mounts /api/v1/analytics) but the gateway proxy SERVICE_MAP has no key for them, so client requests to those prefixes 404.
fix: Add 'connector-registry' (and 'analytics' if intended to be public) to SERVICE_MAP, or remove the dead dual-mount.

title: Plugin pre-uninstall queue reads REDIS_URL not OP_REDIS_URL — connects to localhost, check skipped
description: plugin-service.ts:135 reads process.env.REDIS_URL (never set; entrypoint exports OP_REDIS_URL), so the 'execution' BullMQ queue connects to localhost:6379, getJobs throws, the error is caught and logged, and the pre-uninstall active-jobs safety check is silently skipped. index.ts:459 uses the correct two-stage fallback.
fix: Read OP_REDIS_URL ?? REDIS_URL ?? localhost, matching index.ts.

title: ontology:map queue has producers in 3 paths but no consumer worker
description: webhook-receive, upload, and sync services all enqueue to BullMQ 'ontology:map' (each with a TODO noting no consumer), but no Worker subscribes to it anywhere, so ontology mapping is never triggered and jobs accumulate in Redis forever.
fix: Implement an 'ontology:map' Worker (ontology or ingestion service) that runs the mapping logic.

title: Rate-limit env var mismatch: compose sets OP_GLOBAL_RATE_LIMIT, gateway reads OP_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN
description: Compose sets OP_GLOBAL_RATE_LIMIT (10000) but gateway/src/index.ts:629 reads OP_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN (default 1000), so the configured value is ignored and the gateway always uses 1000/min.
fix: Align the env var names (rename in compose or read both in the gateway).

title: Cookie Secure flag derived from request URL, never set behind TLS-terminating proxy
description: auth.ts:137 and :274 set Secure from c.req.url.startsWith('https://'); the auth service runs on plain HTTP behind Caddy/gateway, so c.req.url is always http:// and the Secure flag is never set on op_access_token/op_refresh_token. x-forwarded-proto is not consulted. bootstrap.ts:107 has the same bug.
fix: Set isSecure from c.req.url.startsWith('https://') || x-forwarded-proto === 'https'.

title: lineage:read scope referenced but never defined — non-admins always 403
description: lineage routes require scope 'lineage:read' || 'admin', but 'lineage:read' is in neither ALL_SCOPES nor any role mapping in token-service.ts, so no non-admin token ever has it. tenant-admin/developer/etc. are wrongly blocked from viewing lineage.
fix: Add lineage:read to ALL_SCOPES and map it to appropriate roles, or use an existing scope (e.g. ontology:read).

title: X-User-Context forwarded to docker-bff without HMAC signature
description: bff-docker builds a userContext JSON and forwards it as X-User-Context without calling signUserContext, and omits scopes. docker-bff currently ignores it, but if it ever adopts serviceAuthMiddleware (which requires X-User-Context-Signature) the BFF breaks; the unsigned context is also a latent trust gap.
fix: Attach signUserContext HMAC and include scopes in the forwarded context.

title: Refresh-token rate limiter accepts client-controlled X-Forwarded-For
description: The refresh limiter falls back to x-forwarded-for[0] when cf-connecting-ip/x-real-ip are absent; on the auth service's internal interface this is client-controllable, letting an attacker rotate apparent IP for unlimited refresh attempts. The gateway limiter deliberately does NOT use XFF.
fix: Trust only x-real-ip (gateway-injected from the socket); drop the XFF fallback.

title: loadServicePublicKeys fails open silently (empty key map)
description: execution/ingestion/plugin/gateway all catch errors loading /data/service-keys and return {} silently; a missing/unreadable key dir leaves servicePublicKeys empty, causing all inbound /internal/* calls to 401 with no startup warning.
fix: Log a warning (and fail readiness in non-test env) when zero service public keys load.

title: MinIO credentials have dev-default fallbacks not covered by the production guard
description: The storage client falls back to minioadmin / oneplatform_minio_dev_2024 via OP_MINIO_ACCESS_KEY/SECRET_KEY, but the production guard only checks OP_MINIO_USER/PASSWORD and runs after construction, so a deployment using the access/secret pair (or none) can silently run with dev credentials.
fix: Unify the credential env var names, run the guard before client construction, and include the access/secret pair in the guard.

title: Streaming routes + StreamingIngestionService fully implemented but never mounted
description: createStreamingRoutes is exported and StreamingIngestionService/kafka-connector are implemented, but index.ts never imports or mounts them, so POST /connectors/:id/stream/start|stop and GET /stream/status all 404.
fix: Instantiate the streaming service and mount createStreamingRoutes in ingestion index.ts.

title: pipeline:cron queue created and health-reported but has no worker
description: queue:pipeline:cron is created and its depth is exposed in /readyz, but no Worker consumes it (cron scheduling uses an in-process setInterval loop), so it wastes a Redis connection and reports misleading metrics.
fix: Remove the cron queue (and its health entry) or wire a real Worker for it.

title: api-keys and tenants use offset pagination while the rest of the platform uses cursor
description: auth api-keys and tenants endpoints use offset/limit and return {total,limit,offset}, whereas every other service (and auth users) uses keyset cursor pagination, forcing SDK clients to implement two strategies.
fix: Standardize api-keys/tenants on keyset cursor pagination.

title: app-service MinIO env var names mismatch compose, always using dev default
description: index.ts:793-794 reads OP_MINIO_ACCESS_KEY/OP_MINIO_SECRET_KEY but compose sets OP_MINIO_USER/OP_MINIO_PASSWORD, so the main storage client always uses 'minioadmin', while build-service.ts correctly reads OP_MINIO_USER — two clients with different creds in one service.
fix: Read OP_MINIO_USER/OP_MINIO_PASSWORD (with the access/secret pair as secondary fallback) consistently.

title: PKCE code exchange and refresh use global fetch instead of injected fetchImpl
description: exchangeCode (156) and refreshAccessToken (199) call the global fetch, bypassing a caller-provided custom fetch (TLS pinning, proxy, test mock) for the security-sensitive token exchange/refresh.
fix: Thread fetchImpl from createPkceHandler through both functions.

title: Infinite SSE reconnect loop when connections are stable ≥10s before dropping
description: scheduleReconnect resets the attempt counter to 0 whenever the prior connection survived ≥10s, so a server that drops every connection at ~10s causes the MAX_RECONNECT_ATTEMPTS cap to never be reached — infinite reconnects.
fix: Track a total lifetime attempt counter that never resets; only reset the backoff delay after a stable session.

title: CSS sanitizer misses CSS-escaped url() forms (XSS)
description: sanitizeCss matches only the literal ASCII 'url'; CSS-escaped forms like \75rl(javascript:…) parse as url() in browsers but bypass the regex, allowing url(javascript:…)/url(data:text/html…) injection into a page-wide <style> tag — reflected XSS via tenant branding.
fix: Use a real CSS allowlist parser, or normalize CSS escape sequences before the scheme check and block data: in custom CSS.

title: Module-level QueryCache singleton not scoped to tenant/app
description: queryCache is a module singleton whose keys encode entity/filter/sort/fields/limit but no tenantId/appId, so co-existing AppProvider instances (micro-frontends, SSR, cross-tenant embed iframes) can serve tenant A's data to tenant B; AppProvider unmount never clears it.
fix: Include appId/tenantId in the cache key and clear the cache on AppProvider cleanup.

title: Unbounded Retry-After delay allows server-controlled DoS
description: The 429 handler sleeps for the full Retry-After value (retryAfterMs = parsed*1000) with no cap, so a server can return Retry-After: 86400 and freeze the tab for 24h. The 5xx backoff path is capped; the 429 path is not.
fix: Cap retryAfterMs (e.g. Math.min(parsed*1000, 60000)).

title: sanitizeHtmlForCodeGen allowlist bypass into generated TSX (dangerouslySetInnerHTML)
description: The regex strips <script>/<iframe>/on* but not <object data=…>, <embed>, <link rel=import>, SVG use href=javascript:, or CSS expression(); the 'sanitized' HTML is emitted into generated .tsx via dangerouslySetInnerHTML, giving false confidence.
fix: Use a DOM sanitizer (DOMPurify), or render user HtmlBlock content only inside the sandboxed iframe and never via dangerouslySetInnerHTML in generated code.

title: Documented API paths wrong: /api/v1/auth/* prefix does not exist
description: auth.mdx documents api-keys/roles/users/oauth under /api/v1/auth/*, but the actual routes are /api/v1/api-keys, /roles, /users, /oauth (gateway SERVICE_MAP keys). Developers following the docs get 404s for every operation. execution.mdx (/runs vs /exec), pipeline.mdx (/run vs /trigger), and plugin.mdx (activate vs instances) have the same class of error.
fix: Correct all documented paths to match the services' openapi-meta and the gateway SERVICE_MAP.

title: All success responses hardcoded as application/json — breaks SSE endpoint spec
description: spec-builder emits application/json for every response, but GET /api/v1/events returns text/event-stream, so the generated OpenAPI misdocuments the SSE stream and misleads codegen.
fix: Add an optional responseContentType to RouteMeta (default application/json) and use it.

title: mergeSecuritySchemes is last-write-wins, silently overwriting conflicts
description: Unlike mergeSchemas (which throws on conflict), mergeSecuritySchemes overwrites schemes by name, so two services defining BearerAuth differently produce a silently-wrong merged spec.
fix: Add conflict detection matching mergeSchemas.

title: Newline/carriage-return accepted as CSV delimiter — corrupt parse
description: Delimiter validation only rejects length>1, so '\n'/'\r'/'\t' pass and are used as field separators in parseRow, collapsing the whole file into mis-split rows with no error.
fix: Reject '\n','\r','' (and ideally '"') as delimiters in extractConfig.

title: Full CSV source URL (with credentials) logged at info level
description: logger.info logs the complete cfg.url, leaking presigned/tokenized URLs (S3/GCS/GitHub) into logs.
fix: Log only new URL(cfg.url).origin; redact path/query.

title: Untrusted plugin configSchema compiled by Ajv without depth/size limits
description: configSchema is z.record(z.unknown()); getOrCompileValidator compiles it via ajv.compile with no constraints, so a malicious plugin can submit a deeply recursive $ref / exponential anyOf schema that hangs or exhausts CPU/memory on first instance creation.
fix: Enforce a schema size/depth limit and disable $ref/loadSchema, or compile in a worker with a timeout.

title: ingestion sync/reconciliation read EXECUTION_SERVICE_URL directly with wrong hardcoded fallback
description: sync-service.ts:287 and reconciliation-service.ts:371 read process.env.EXECUTION_SERVICE_URL ?? 'http://execution-service:3005' directly (instead of the injected config), bypassing the configured URL and using a wrong port not set in compose.
fix: Thread executionServiceUrl through the service constructors rather than reading process.env inside the services.

title: Billing webhook upsert returns 200 on create instead of 201
description: The create/replace endpoint always returns 200, so callers cannot distinguish create from update.
fix: Return 201 on create and 200 on update, or document as a pure upsert.

title: JSON.parse of Redis metering metadata can throw and abort the whole flush
description: A corrupt metadata string throws SyntaxError out of entries.map, bypassing per-tenant error isolation and failing the flush for all remaining tenants.
fix: Wrap the JSON.parse in try/catch and treat parse failure as absent metadata.

title: SSE replay returns 'overflow' for empty/fresh tenant buffer
description: When a tenant has no events (fresh or fully evicted), replay returns 'overflow', causing clients to needlessly re-fetch 'missed' data even though nothing was lost.
fix: Return [] when the buffer is missing/empty; reserve 'overflow' for a populated-buffer miss.

title: Bootstrap token timingSafeEqual can throw on non-hex input
description: Buffer.from(token.padEnd(64,'0'),'hex') silently drops non-hex chars producing a shorter buffer; if it differs in length from the 32-byte expected buffer, timingSafeEqual throws ERR_CRYPTO_TIMING_SAFE_EQUAL_LENGTH instead of returning a clean invalid-token error. (Zod normally catches this upstream.)
fix: Assert providedBytes.length===32 (or Buffer.alloc(32) fallback) before timingSafeEqual.

title: prefixPublicRoutes is dead code — public-route prefix matching never works
description: prefixPublicRoutes is declared but never populated (routes go to exact or wildcard buckets), yet isPublicRoute still checks it. A route added expecting subtree exemption only gets an exact match, surprising future maintainers.
fix: Remove the dead array/branch or implement prefix population.

title: promptPassphrase Ctrl+D/Ctrl+C comparisons use wrong literals
description: In raw mode Ctrl+D is 0x04 and Ctrl+C is 0x03, but the handler compares char === '^D'/'^C' (two-char strings that never match), so Ctrl+D never submits and the Ctrl+C reject branch is dead.
fix: Compare against '\x04' and '\x03'.

title: Config directory created with default 0755 permissions
description: ensureConfigDir uses mkdirSync(recursive) with no mode, so ~/.config/oneplatform is world-readable; credentials.json is chmod 0600 but profile/config JSON (platformUrl, tenantId) are readable by other local users.
fix: Create the dir with mode 0o700 and write profile files 0o600.

title: Generated API key suppressed by --quiet and permanently lost
description: generate-key/rotate-key output the one-time key via renderer.info() which returns early when quiet=true; since the server never re-exposes the key, `op auth generate-key --quiet` yields no key and no recovery path.
fix: Write one-time secrets directly to stdout, bypassing the quiet guard (or error if --quiet would suppress them).

title: Token manager clears refreshInFlight only in finally — extra refresh on failure window
description: On a failed refresh, refreshInFlight is cleared in finally; a third caller entering between the rejection and the finally sees null and starts a fresh refresh on an already-failed token.
fix: Set refreshInFlight=null at the start of the catch before re-throwing.

title: 'complete' SSE event defaults to 'success' on parse failure
description: If the complete-event payload fails JSON.parse, buildResult is hard-set to 'success', so a failed build that emitted a malformed payload is reported successful, hiding failures.
fix: Set buildResult to null or 'failed' on an unreadable payload.

title: Preview sandbox silently downgrades to same-origin mode on config fetch error
description: When the runtime-config query errors, wildcardDomain is undefined so isModeA=false and the preview falls back to Mode B (same-origin, allow-scripts/allow-forms) with no isError branch — a silent isolation downgrade for operators who configured Mode A.
fix: Add an explicit isError branch that renders an error instead of an iframe.

title: Decoded MySQL cursor offset not validated as non-negative integer
description: decodeCursor only checks typeof offset==='number', so a crafted cursor with offset:-1 reaches the proxy as OFFSET -1, producing a SQL error that may leak internal messages.
fix: Reject non-integer/negative offsets in decodeCursor.

title: Postgres connector identifiers stored untrimmed and unvalidated
description: table/schema/primaryKey/incrementalColumn are validated with .trim() but stored raw, and have no identifier-character allowlist, so values like '  users  ' or 'users; DROP…' reach the proxy as identifiers (proxy-dependent injection risk; wrong-object queries).
fix: Trim before storing and enforce an identifier regex.

title: CSV cache key collides for same URL with different parse config
description: connectionId is derived solely from cfg.url, so two connectors on the same URL with different delimiter/hasHeader/encoding share the same cache entry and the first to populate wins — wrong column names / consumed header for the second.
fix: Include delimiter/hasHeader/encoding (or their hash) in the cache key.
